settings.vault.upstream.label: Upstream vault
settings.vault.upstream.sub: The remote vault this agent forwards /api/* to. Set during pairing.
settings.vault.device.label: Device id
settings.vault.device.sub: Identifier the upstream vault sees for this agent.

settings.vault.pair.sub: Run this command in a terminal on the machine you want to pair.
settings.vault.local.label: Local-only
settings.vault.local.sub: Vault and agent run together on this machine. Pair another device by deploying a vault somewhere reachable, then running the pair command on that device.
settings.vault.unpair.label: Unpair from this vault
settings.vault.unpair.sub: Disconnect from the cloud vault. The daemon will restart and fall back to local mode; cloud accounts stay on the vault until you pair again.
settings.devices.sub: Every device currently paired to this vault. Removing one here doesn't affect this device.
settings.devices.empty: No paired devices on this vault yet.
pair.title: Pair with vault
pair.subtitle: Walk through the device-flow handshake without dropping to a terminal.

pair.polling.intro: Approve this code in the vault's web UI to finish pairing.
pair.polling.waiting: Waiting for approval — this window will update automatically.
pair.approved.intro: This device is paired and the bearer token has been saved locally.
pair.approved.next_step: Pairing successful. Restarting the daemon to activate agent mode…
pair.error.denied: The vault denied this pairing request.
pair.error.expired: The pairing code expired before it was approved.
pair.error.save_failed: Could not save the pairing token
settings.auto_switch.policy_sub: How the daemon picks the next account when the current one cools or hits its threshold.
settings.launch_at_login.label: Launch at login
settings.launch_at_login.sub: Start Foxy Switcher when you sign in. The window stays hidden in the tray on autostart so it doesn't steal focus.
settings.data_dir.label: Data directory
settings.update.auto.label: Check for updates on launch
settings.update.auto.sub: Quietly query GitHub for a newer release once at startup, with a 1-day cache.
settings.update.check_now.label: Check for updates now
settings.update.check_now.sub: Skip the cache and ask GitHub right now. A banner appears if a newer release is available.
settings.language.label: Language
settings.language.sub: Override the auto-detected interface language. Reloads the app when changed.
settings.theme.label: Theme
settings.restore.label: Restore native credentials on quit
settings.restore.sub: Put your original ~/.claude/.credentials.json back when the daemon exits.
settings.marker_state.label: Credential integrity
settings.marker_state.sub: Whether Claude Code has rewritten ~/.claude/.credentials.json since Foxy last injected.
settings.poll.label: Usage poll interval
settings.poll.sub: How often the daemon polls Anthropic usage. 30–300s. Applies on next daemon start.
settings.threshold_default.label: Default threshold
settings.threshold_default.sub: Pool default for new accounts' per-window utilization threshold.
settings.threshold_default.apply.label: Apply to all accounts
settings.threshold_default.apply.sub: Overwrite every existing account's thresholds with the three defaults above (including manually-tuned ones).
settings.about.app_sub: Local Claude account pool · Tauri 2 + Go sidecar
settings.about.daemon.attached: Sharing a daemon another process started (TUI embed or a manual run).
settings.about.daemon.owned: This window started the daemon and will SIGTERM it on quit.
settings.about.daemon.unknown: Live health is shown in the Sidebar footer.
settings.danger.reset.label: Reset all data
settings.danger.reset.sub: Wipes the account pool, settings, activity log, and usage history, then restarts the daemon. The native ~/.claude credentials are not touched.
settings.danger.reset.disabled_attached_: Disabled in attached daemon mode — restart that daemon manually
settings.footnote: Changes save the moment you flip a control.
drawer.attr.hint: Estimated: the current window's usage increase split across devices by how long each held this account.
drawer.attr.thin_data: Not enough history yet — just started recording, or usage hasn't changed.
drawer.attr.accumulating: Building device-usage data: usage was seen but none of it falls inside a recorded device-hold window yet (the account may have been held before recording began). Per-device shares will appear here after a while of use.
onboarding.title: Welcome to Foxy Switcher
onboarding.subtitle: A 45-second tour of how Foxy keeps your Claude accounts rotating.
onboarding.choose.title: Where should your accounts live?
onboarding.choose.body: Foxy stores your Claude tokens in a vault. The vault can run on this device, or on a server you own that other devices share.
onboarding.choose.local.title: Local vault
onboarding.choose.local.body: Vault and agent both run on this device. Quickest way to start — switch to cloud later in Settings.
onboarding.choose.cloud.title: Cloud vault
onboarding.choose.cloud.body: Pair this device with a vault you've deployed on a server. Multiple devices share one account pool.
onboarding.cloud.url.title: Connect to your vault
onboarding.cloud.pair.intro: Approve this device on your vault.
onboarding.cloud.pair.failure: Couldn't reach the vault. Check the URL and try again.

openrouter.subtitle: Each authorised device derives its own capped key from this account. The management key never leaves the vault.
openrouter.field.name: Name
openrouter.field.models_hint: One OpenRouter model slug per line. This same list is enforced upstream and decides which models appear in each device's model picker.
openrouter.field.limit_invalid: Enter a number of 0 or more.
openrouter.field.workspace_placeholder: Leave blank for the default workspace
openrouter.field.management_key_keep: Leave blank to keep the stored key
openrouter.field.management_key_hint: Either kind works — foxy asks OpenRouter which it is when you save. A provisioning key lets each device get its own revocable key; an ordinary key is shared by every authorised device, which is fine for one machine. Stored on the vault only.
openrouter.revoke_warning: Saving revokes the {count} key(s) devices already hold — each carries the current policy. Devices re-derive automatically.
openrouter.check_hint: Checks the key is a management key and whether this plan enforces the model allowlist server-side.
openrouter.kind.provisioning: Provisioning key — each device gets its own key, revocable on its own.
openrouter.kind.shared: Ordinary key — shared by every authorised device, so revoking one device cannot revoke it.
openrouter.credit.remaining: ${remaining} credit remaining on this OpenRouter account.
openrouter.credit.empty: Out of credit (${remaining} left) — devices roll onto the next funded account.
openrouter.credit.unknown: Credit not checked yet. Press Test key, or wait for the next balance poll.
